reviewer_role: runtime author, independent of proof author; this is proof review, not self-approval of the runtime
scope: G190/B80: continuous 190m dry STONE45, grip1/resistance.2, 120Hz, push drain scale1, no internal shelf/ledge/support/purchase/external forward impulse, fixed ranks, entry S<=capacity and v<=1.8, min stamina1, released recovery rate7 and time quota80/7

findings.assessment: For old v>.001 and no slip, a<=F-(g+r). Semi-implicit H=c*x+positive(v)^2/2 yields deltaH=(a+c)*v_next*dt-(a*dt)^2/2<=F*v_next*dt. Speed clipping only lowers effective acceleration. If new velocity is nonpositive H cannot increase.

The proof correctly avoids using c=g+r as the negative-velocity opposing force. With old v<=.001, g>r and rollback force reduction imply v_next<=.001+F0*dt. Dropping old positive kinetic energy gives the stated R_low bound. Bracing clamps positive outcomes to zero, and slip removes forward momentum, so neither supplies positive H.

E(S)=integral_0^S rho(u+q)du is nondecreasing and 1-Lipschitz. For paid d<=q, every u in [S-d,S] obeys u+q>=S, hence E drop>=rho(S)*d. Repeated crossings of 20% and 50% tiers do not invalidate telescoping. E(C)=.885*C+.35*q is correct for the audited capacities.

If S<d<=q=.0425 then rho=.65, leaving at most .65*q unpaid weighted drain. Min stamina1 makes S=0 absorbing while inside the gate, so there is at most one such step after the last lower-boundary entry. The essential condition is strictly positive recovery_min_stamina; min1>=q is sufficient, but that stronger inequality is not needed for this proof. With min0 this certificate is invalid.

Eligible_dt=min(dt,remaining time) handles the last fractional opportunity. Actual increase=min(missing stamina,r*R*eligible_dt); eligible time is consumed even at cap. Therefore total actual recovery<=r*T*R. Retreat/reentry cannot refund the ledger. On a fresh final entry, allowing the full original quota is an overestimate and remains safe.

Subtracting 1.8/120=.015m from the gate length covers the discrete lower-boundary crossing step. Entry kinetic energy<=1.62. The resulting shortage5.626722965051 is positive. This does not certify other drain scales, geometry, wet surfaces, min0, dynamic ranks, safe retreat, human time, or IEEE formal correctness.
